# The contract of every item in formal/verus/src, one item per line.
# A spec fn keeps its body, because its definition gives a contract its
# meaning. Any other fn keeps its signature and its requires, ensures and
# decreases clauses. Verus checks its body.
#
# Do not edit this file by hand. A change here shows that a proof now
# states a different property. Rewrite it with:
#   UPDATE_VERUS_CONTRACTS=1 cargo test -p autumn-harvest --test integration \
#     verus_proofs_coverage::every_verus_contract_matches_the_stored_list

## formal/verus/src/agent_dedupe.rs
pub open spec fn spec_is_new(floor: int, seq: int, in_above: bool) -> bool { seq > floor &&! in_above }
pub open spec fn spec_next_floor(floor: int, next_in_above: bool) -> int { if next_in_above && floor < u64::MAX { floor + 1 } else { floor } }
pub fn is_new(floor: u64, seq: u64, in_above: bool) -> (r: bool) ensures r == spec_is_new(floor as int, seq as int, in_above), seq <= floor ==>! r, in_above ==>! r,
pub fn next_floor(floor: u64, next_in_above: bool) -> (r: u64) ensures r == spec_next_floor(floor as int, next_in_above), floor <= r <= floor + 1, r == floor + 1 <==> (next_in_above && floor < u64::MAX),
pub open spec fn contains(floor: int, above: Set < int >, s: int) -> bool { ! spec_is_new(floor, s, above.contains(s)) }
pub open spec fn encodes(floor: int, above: Set < int >, applied: Set < int >) -> bool { forall | s: int | 1 <= s ==> (#[trigger] applied.contains(s) == contains(floor, above, s)) }
pub open spec fn sound(floor: int, above: Set < int >, applied: Set < int >) -> bool { forall | s: int | 1 <= s && #[trigger] contains(floor, above, s) ==> applied.contains(s) }
pub open spec fn fold(floor: int, above: Set < int >) -> (int, Set < int >) decreases u64::MAX - floor, { let next = spec_next_floor(floor, above.contains(floor + 1)); if next == floor { (floor, above) } else { fold(next, above.remove(next)) } }
pub open spec fn apply(floor: int, above: Set < int >, seq: int) -> (int, Set < int >) { if spec_is_new(floor, seq, above.contains(seq)) { fold(floor, above.insert(seq)) } else { (floor, above) } }
pub open spec fn apply_all(floor: int, above: Set < int >, seqs: Seq < int >) -> (int, Set < int >) decreases seqs.len(), { if seqs.len() == 0 { (floor, above) } else { let next = apply(floor, above, seqs [0]); apply_all(next.0, next.1, seqs.drop_first()) } }
pub proof fn theorem_a_fold_keeps_the_applied_set(floor: int, above: Set < int >, s: int) ensures contains(fold(floor, above).0, fold(floor, above).1, s) == contains(floor, above, s), decreases u64::MAX - floor,
pub proof fn theorem_the_floor_never_moves_over_a_gap(floor: int, above: Set < int >, s: int) ensures floor <= fold(floor, above).0, floor < s <= fold(floor, above).0 ==> above.contains(s), decreases u64::MAX - floor,
pub proof fn theorem_an_apply_is_the_plain_insert(floor: int, above: Set < int >, applied: Set < int >, seq: int,) requires encodes(floor, above, applied), 1 <= seq, ensures spec_is_new(floor, seq, above.contains(seq)) ==! applied.contains(seq), encodes(apply(floor, above, seq).0, apply(floor, above, seq).1, applied.insert(seq)),
proof fn lemma_apply_all_is_the_union(floor: int, above: Set < int >, applied: Set < int >, seqs: Seq < int >,) requires encodes(floor, above, applied), forall | i: int | 0 <= i < seqs.len() ==> 1 <= #[trigger] seqs [i], ensures encodes(apply_all(floor, above, seqs).0, apply_all(floor, above, seqs).1, applied.union(seqs.to_set()),), decreases seqs.len(),
pub proof fn theorem_each_number_applies_once(seqs: Seq < int >, i: int) requires forall | j: int | 0 <= j < seqs.len() ==> 1 <= #[trigger] seqs [j], 0 <= i < seqs.len(), ensures ({ let before = apply_all(0, Set::empty(), seqs.take(i)); spec_is_new(before.0, seqs [i], before.1.contains(seqs [i])) ==! seqs.take(i).contains(seqs [i],) }), encodes(apply_all(0, Set::empty(), seqs).0, apply_all(0, Set::empty(), seqs).1, seqs.to_set(),),
pub proof fn theorem_the_bound_makes_no_false_duplicate(floor: int, above: Set < int >, applied: Set < int >, seq: int, forgot: int,) requires sound(floor, above, applied), 1 <= seq, ensures ! spec_is_new(floor, seq, above.contains(seq)) ==> applied.contains(seq), sound(apply(floor, above, seq).0, apply(floor, above, seq).1, applied.insert(seq)), sound(floor, above.remove(forgot), applied),

## formal/verus/src/agent_inbox.rs
pub enum InboxStatus { Open, Paused, Parked, }
pub enum OpClass { Work, Control, Tick, }
pub enum Admit { Run, Hold, Apply, Skip, }
pub open spec fn decision(status: InboxStatus, class: OpClass) -> Admit { match class { OpClass::Control => Admit::Apply, OpClass::Work => match status { InboxStatus::Open => Admit::Run, _ => Admit::Hold, }, OpClass::Tick => match status { InboxStatus::Open => Admit::Run, _ => Admit::Skip, }, } }
pub fn decide(status: InboxStatus, class: OpClass) -> (r: Admit) ensures r == decision(status, class), class == OpClass::Control <==> r == Admit::Apply, class == OpClass::Work ==> r != Admit::Skip, class == OpClass::Work ==> (r == Admit::Run <==> status == InboxStatus::Open), class == OpClass::Tick ==> r != Admit::Hold, r == Admit::Hold ==> class == OpClass::Work,
pub enum InboxOp { Work(int), Tick, Pause, Park, Resume, Other, }
pub open spec fn class_of(op: InboxOp) -> OpClass { match op { InboxOp::Work(_) => OpClass::Work, InboxOp::Tick => OpClass::Tick, _ => OpClass::Control, } }
pub struct Inbox { pub status: InboxStatus, pub held: Seq < int >, pub ran: Seq < int >, }
pub open spec fn fresh() -> Inbox { Inbox { status: InboxStatus::Open, held: Seq::empty(), ran: Seq::empty() } }
pub open spec fn inv(inbox: Inbox) -> bool { inbox.status == InboxStatus::Open ==> inbox.held.len() == 0 }
pub open spec fn apply_control(inbox: Inbox, op: InboxOp) -> Inbox { match op { InboxOp::Pause => Inbox { status: InboxStatus::Paused, held: inbox.held, ran: inbox.ran }, InboxOp::Park => Inbox { status: InboxStatus::Parked, held: inbox.held, ran: inbox.ran }, InboxOp::Resume => Inbox { status: InboxStatus::Open, held: Seq::empty(), ran: inbox.ran + inbox.held, }, _ => inbox, } }
pub open spec fn step(inbox: Inbox, op: InboxOp) -> Inbox { match decision(inbox.status, class_of(op)) { Admit::Run => match op { InboxOp::Work(id) => Inbox { status: inbox.status, held: inbox.held, ran: inbox.ran.push(id) }, _ => inbox, }, Admit::Hold => match op { InboxOp::Work(id) => Inbox { status: inbox.status, held: inbox.held.push(id), ran: inbox.ran }, _ => inbox, }, Admit::Apply => apply_control(inbox, op), Admit::Skip => inbox, } }
pub open spec fn run(inbox: Inbox, ops: Seq < InboxOp >) -> Inbox decreases ops.len(), { if ops.len() == 0 { inbox } else { run(step(inbox, ops [0]), ops.drop_first()) } }
pub open spec fn work_ids(ops: Seq < InboxOp >) -> Seq < int > decreases ops.len(), { if ops.len() == 0 { Seq::empty() } else { let head = match ops [0] { InboxOp::Work(id) => seq ! [id], _ => Seq::empty(), }; head + work_ids(ops.drop_first()) } }
proof fn lemma_step_keeps_the_order(inbox: Inbox, op: InboxOp) requires inv(inbox), ensures inv(step(inbox, op)), step(inbox, op).ran + step(inbox, op).held == inbox.ran + inbox.held + work_ids(seq ! [op]),
proof fn lemma_run_keeps_the_order(inbox: Inbox, ops: Seq < InboxOp >) requires inv(inbox), ensures inv(run(inbox, ops)), run(inbox, ops).ran + run(inbox, ops).held == inbox.ran + inbox.held + work_ids(ops), decreases ops.len(),
pub proof fn theorem_an_acknowledged_op_is_never_lost(ops: Seq < InboxOp >) ensures run(fresh(), ops).ran + run(fresh(), ops).held == work_ids(ops),
pub proof fn theorem_an_open_inbox_has_run_every_op(ops: Seq < InboxOp >) ensures run(fresh(), ops).status == InboxStatus::Open ==> run(fresh(), ops).held.len() == 0, run(fresh(), ops).status == InboxStatus::Open ==> run(fresh(), ops).ran == work_ids(ops),
pub proof fn theorem_a_resume_runs_every_held_op(ops: Seq < InboxOp >) requires ops.len() > 0, ops.last() == InboxOp::Resume, ensures run(fresh(), ops).status == InboxStatus::Open, run(fresh(), ops).ran == work_ids(ops),
proof fn lemma_run_ends_with_its_last_step(inbox: Inbox, ops: Seq < InboxOp >) requires ops.len() > 0, ensures run(inbox, ops) == step(run(inbox, ops.drop_last()), ops.last()), decreases ops.len(),

## formal/verus/src/agent_overlay.rs
pub open spec fn within(value: Option < u32 >, ceiling: Option < u32 >) -> bool { match ceiling { None => true, Some(cap) => value.is_some() && value.unwrap() <= cap, } }
pub open spec fn spec_merged_bound(current: Option < u32 >, set: Option < u32 >, ceiling: Option < u32 >) -> Result < Option < u32 >, (), > { let next = if set.is_some() { set } else { current }; if within(next, ceiling) { Ok(next) } else { Err(()) } }
pub fn merged_bound(current: Option < u32 >, set: Option < u32 >, ceiling: Option < u32 >) -> (r: Result < Option < u32 >, (), >) ensures r == spec_merged_bound(current, set, ceiling), r is Ok ==> within(r -> Ok_0, ceiling), r is Ok && set.is_some() ==> r -> Ok_0 == set, r is Ok && set.is_none() ==> r -> Ok_0 == current,
pub open spec fn spec_merged_read_only(current: bool, set: Option < bool >, allow_clear: bool) -> Option < bool, > { let next = if set.is_some() { set.unwrap() } else { current }; if current &&! next &&! allow_clear { None } else { Some(next) } }
pub fn merged_read_only(current: bool, set: Option < bool >, allow_clear: bool) -> (r: Option < bool >) ensures r == spec_merged_read_only(current, set, allow_clear), r.is_some() && current &&! r.unwrap() ==> allow_clear, r.is_some() && set.is_none() ==> r.unwrap() == current,
pub open spec fn default_model() -> int { 0 }
pub open spec fn name(model: Option < int >) -> int { if model.is_some() { model.unwrap() } else { default_model() } }
pub struct Profile { pub max_steps: u32, pub max_total_tokens: Option < u32 >, pub max_output_tokens: Option < u32 >, pub read_only: bool, pub model: Option < int >, pub allowed: Option < Set < int >>, pub guidance: Set < int >, pub rest: int, }
pub struct Overlay { pub max_steps: Option < u32 >, pub max_total_tokens: Option < u32 >, pub max_output_tokens: Option < u32 >, pub read_only: Option < bool >, pub model: Option < int >, pub guidance: Set < int >, }
pub struct Ceilings { pub max_steps: Option < u32 >, pub max_total_tokens: Option < u32 >, pub max_output_tokens: Option < u32 >, pub models: Set < int >, pub allow_clear_read_only: bool, }
pub open spec fn from_profile(p: Profile) -> Ceilings { Ceilings { max_steps: Some(p.max_steps), max_total_tokens: p.max_total_tokens, max_output_tokens: p.max_output_tokens, models: set ! [name(p.model)], allow_clear_read_only: false, } }
pub open spec fn allows(allowed: Option < Set < int >>, model: int) -> bool { allowed.is_none() || allowed.unwrap().contains(model) }
pub open spec fn apply(p: Profile, o: Overlay, c: Ceilings, registry: Set < int >, tools: Set < int >) -> Option < Profile, > { let steps = spec_merged_bound(Some(p.max_steps), o.max_steps, c.max_steps); let total = spec_merged_bound(p.max_total_tokens, o.max_total_tokens, c.max_total_tokens); let output = spec_merged_bound(p.max_output_tokens, o.max_output_tokens, c.max_output_tokens); let read_only = spec_merged_read_only(p.read_only, o.read_only, c.allow_clear_read_only); let model = if o.model.is_some() { o.model } else { p.model }; let forbidden = o.model.is_some() &&! allows(p.allowed, o.model.unwrap()); if ! (steps is Ok) || (steps -> Ok_0).is_none() ||! (total is Ok) ||! (output is Ok) || read_only.is_none() { None } else if forbidden ||! c.models.contains(name(model)) { None } else if o.model.is_some() &&! registry.contains(o.model.unwrap()) { None } else if ! p.guidance.union(o.guidance).subset_of(tools) { None } else { Some(Profile { max_steps: (steps -> Ok_0).unwrap(), max_total_tokens: total -> Ok_0, max_output_tokens: output -> Ok_0, read_only: read_only.unwrap(), model, allowed: p.allowed, guidance: p.guidance.union(o.guidance), rest: p.rest, },) } }
pub proof fn theorem_apply_refuses_exactly(p: Profile, o: Overlay, c: Ceilings, registry: Set < int >, tools: Set < int >,) ensures ({ let steps = if o.max_steps.is_some() { o.max_steps.unwrap() } else { p.max_steps }; let total = if o.max_total_tokens.is_some() { o.max_total_tokens } else { p.max_total_tokens }; let output = if o.max_output_tokens.is_some() { o.max_output_tokens } else { p.max_output_tokens }; let read_only = if o.read_only.is_some() { o.read_only.unwrap() } else { p.read_only }; let model = if o.model.is_some() { o.model } else { p.model }; let ok = within(Some(steps), c.max_steps) && within(total, c.max_total_tokens) && within(output, c.max_output_tokens) &&! (p.read_only &&! read_only &&! c.allow_clear_read_only) && (o.model.is_some() ==> allows(p.allowed, o.model.unwrap(),) && registry.contains(o.model.unwrap())) && c.models.contains(name(model)) && p.guidance.union(o.guidance).subset_of(tools); &&& apply(p, o, c, registry, tools).is_some() == ok &&& ok ==> apply(p, o, c, registry, tools) == Some(Profile { max_steps: steps, max_total_tokens: total, max_output_tokens: output, read_only, model, allowed: p.allowed, guidance: p.guidance.union(o.guidance), rest: p.rest, },) }),
pub proof fn theorem_a_result_stays_under_the_ceilings(p: Profile, o: Overlay, c: Ceilings, registry: Set < int >, tools: Set < int >,) ensures apply(p, o, c, registry, tools).is_some() ==>
, { }
pub proof fn theorem_default_ceilings_only_narrow(p: Profile, o: Overlay, registry: Set < int >, tools: Set < int >,) ensures apply(p, o, from_profile(p), registry, tools).is_some() ==>
, { theorem_a_result_stays_under_the_ceilings(p, o, from_profile(p), registry, tools); }
pub proof fn theorem_apply_is_idempotent(p: Profile, o: Overlay, c: Ceilings, registry: Set < int >, tools: Set < int >,) ensures apply(p, o, c, registry, tools).is_some() ==> apply(apply(p, o, c, registry, tools).unwrap(), o, c, registry, tools,) == apply(p, o, c, registry, tools),
pub proof fn theorem_an_empty_overlay_keeps_the_profile(p: Profile, registry: Set < int >, tools: Set < int, >) requires p.guidance.subset_of(tools), ensures apply(p, Overlay { max_steps: None, max_total_tokens: None, max_output_tokens: None, read_only: None, model: None, guidance: Set::empty(), }, from_profile(p), registry, tools,) == Some(p),
pub struct ToolDef { pub name: int, pub description: int, pub effect: int, pub builtin: bool, }
pub open spec fn guided(t: ToolDef, guidance: Map < int, int >) -> ToolDef { if ! t.builtin && guidance.contains_key(t.name) { ToolDef { name: t.name, description: guidance [t.name], effect: t.effect, builtin: false } } else { t } }
pub proof fn theorem_guidance_changes_only_the_description(t: ToolDef, guidance: Map < int, int >) ensures guided(t, guidance).name == t.name, guided(t, guidance).effect == t.effect, guided(t, guidance).builtin == t.builtin, ! t.builtin && guidance.contains_key(t.name) ==> guided(t, guidance).description == guidance [t.name], t.builtin ||! guidance.contains_key(t.name) ==> guided(t, guidance) == t,

## formal/verus/src/agent_profile_read.rs
pub open spec fn spec_op_profile < P, V, E > (base: P, active: Option < (V, Result < P, E >) >) -> Result < (P, Option < V >), (V, E), > { match active { None => Ok((base, None)), Some((version, Ok(applied))) => Ok((applied, Some(version))), Some((version, Err(err))) => Err((version, err)), } }
pub fn op_profile < P, V, E > (base: P, active: Option < (V, Result < P, E >) >) -> (r: Result < (P, Option < V >), (V, E), >) ensures r == spec_op_profile(base, active), active is None ==> r == Ok::< (P, Option < V >), (V, E) > ((base, None)), active is Some ==> (r is Ok <==> (active -> 0).1 is Ok), active is Some && r is Ok ==> (r -> Ok_0).1 == Some((active -> 0).0), active is Some && r is Ok ==> (r -> Ok_0).0 == (active -> 0).1 -> Ok_0, active is Some && r is Err ==> (r -> Err_0).0 == (active -> 0).0,
pub proof fn theorem_an_active_version_never_runs_bare < P, V, E > (base: P, version: V, applied: Result < P, E >,) ensures spec_op_profile(base, Some((version, applied))) is Ok ==> spec_op_profile(base, Some((version, applied)),) -> Ok_0.1 is Some, applied is Err ==> spec_op_profile(base, Some((version, applied))) is Err,
pub proof fn theorem_the_recorded_version_is_the_applied_one < P, V, E > (base: P, version: V, applied: P,) ensures spec_op_profile(base, Some((version, Ok::< P, E > (applied)))) == Ok::< (P, Option < V >), (V, E), > ((applied, Some(version))),

## formal/verus/src/agent_propose.rs
pub enum Verdict { Invalid, Same, Differs, }
pub enum Step { Retry, Propose, Keep, FallBack, }
pub open spec fn step_of(attempt: int, max: int, verdict: Verdict) -> Step { match verdict { Verdict::Differs => Step::Propose, Verdict::Same => Step::Keep, Verdict::Invalid => if attempt < max { Step::Retry } else { Step::FallBack }, } }
pub fn next_step(attempt: u32, max: u32, verdict: Verdict) -> (r: Step) ensures r == step_of(attempt as int, max as int, verdict), r is Retry <==> (verdict is Invalid && attempt < max), r is FallBack <==> (verdict is Invalid && attempt >= max), r is Propose <==> verdict is Differs, r is Keep <==> verdict is Same,
pub open spec fn verdict_at(verdicts: Seq < Verdict >, i: int) -> Verdict { if 1 <= i <= verdicts.len() { verdicts [i - 1] } else { Verdict::Invalid } }
pub open spec fn run(verdicts: Seq < Verdict >, max: int, attempt: int) -> (Step, int) decreases max - attempt, { let step = step_of(attempt, max, verdict_at(verdicts, attempt)); if step is Retry { run(verdicts, max, attempt + 1) } else { (step, attempt) } }
proof fn lemma_run(verdicts: Seq < Verdict >, max: int, attempt: int) requires 1 <= attempt <= max, ensures attempt <= run(verdicts, max, attempt).1 <= max, ! (run(verdicts, max, attempt).0 is Retry), forall | i: int | attempt <= i < run(verdicts, max, attempt).1 ==> #[trigger] verdict_at(verdicts, i) is Invalid, run(verdicts, max, attempt).0 is FallBack ==> run(verdicts, max, attempt).1 == max && verdict_at(verdicts, max) is Invalid, run(verdicts, max, attempt).0 is Propose <==> verdict_at(verdicts, run(verdicts, max, attempt).1,) is Differs, run(verdicts, max, attempt).0 is Keep <==> verdict_at(verdicts, run(verdicts, max, attempt).1,) is Same, decreases max - attempt,
pub proof fn theorem_a_stage_is_bounded(verdicts: Seq < Verdict >, max: int) requires 1 <= max, ensures 1 <= run(verdicts, max, 1).1 <= max, ! (run(verdicts, max, 1).0 is Retry),
pub proof fn theorem_a_stage_falls_back_exactly_when_every_attempt_is_invalid(verdicts: Seq < Verdict >, max: int,) requires 1 <= max, ensures run(verdicts, max, 1).0 is FallBack <==> forall | i: int | 1 <= i <= max ==> #[trigger] verdict_at(verdicts, i) is Invalid, run(verdicts, max, 1).0 is FallBack ==> run(verdicts, max, 1).1 == max,
pub proof fn theorem_a_stage_stops_at_the_first_valid_reply(verdicts: Seq < Verdict >, max: int) requires 1 <= max, ensures ! (run(verdicts, max, 1).0 is FallBack) ==>! (verdict_at(verdicts, run(verdicts, max, 1).1,) is Invalid), forall | i: int | 1 <= i < run(verdicts, max, 1).1 ==> #[trigger] verdict_at(verdicts, i) is Invalid, run(verdicts, max, 1).0 is Keep <==> verdict_at(verdicts, run(verdicts, max, 1).1) is Same, run(verdicts, max, 1).0 is Propose <==> verdict_at(verdicts, run(verdicts, max, 1).1,) is Differs,

## formal/verus/src/agent_reset.rs
pub open spec fn clamped(percent: int) -> int { if percent == 0 { 1 } else if percent > 100 { 100 } else { percent } }
pub open spec fn reaches(len: int, cap: int, percent: int) -> bool { cap > 0 && len * 100 >= cap * clamped(percent) }
pub fn reaches_percent(len: u64, cap: u64, percent: u8) -> (r: bool) ensures r == reaches(len as int, cap as int, percent as int),
pub open spec fn due(resets: int, max_resets: int, len: int, cap: int, percent: int) -> bool { resets < max_resets && reaches(len, cap, percent) }
pub fn reset_due(resets: u32, max_resets: u32, len: u64, cap: u64, percent: u8) -> (r: bool) ensures r == due(resets as int, max_resets as int, len as int, cap as int, percent as int),
pub proof fn theorem_a_request_over_the_cap_reaches_the_threshold(len: int, cap: int, percent: int) requires 0 < cap < len, 0 <= percent, ensures reaches(len, cap, percent),
pub proof fn theorem_a_reset_comes_before_the_cap(resets: int, max_resets: int, len: int, cap: int, percent: int,) requires resets < max_resets, 0 < cap < len, 0 <= percent, ensures due(resets, max_resets, len, cap, percent),
pub proof fn theorem_the_threshold_is_monotone(small: int, large: int, cap: int, percent: int) requires 0 <= small <= large, reaches(small, cap, percent), ensures reaches(large, cap, percent),
pub proof fn theorem_a_request_under_the_threshold_fits(len: int, cap: int, percent: int) requires 0 <= len, 0 < cap, 0 <= percent, ! reaches(len, cap, percent), ensures len < cap,
pub proof fn theorem_a_zero_cap_never_resets(resets: int, max_resets: int, len: int, percent: int) ensures ! due(resets, max_resets, len, 0, percent),
pub open spec fn after(resets: int, max_resets: int, len: int, cap: int, percent: int) -> int { if due(resets, max_resets, len, cap, percent) { resets + 1 } else { resets } }
pub open spec fn count(resets: int, max_resets: int, lens: Seq < int >, cap: int, percent: int) -> int decreases lens.len(), { if lens.len() == 0 { resets } else { count(after(resets, max_resets, lens [0], cap, percent), max_resets, lens.subrange(1, lens.len() as int), cap, percent,) } }
pub proof fn theorem_resets_never_pass_the_cap(resets: int, max_resets: int, lens: Seq < int >, cap: int, percent: int,) requires 0 <= resets <= max_resets, ensures resets <= count(resets, max_resets, lens, cap, percent) <= max_resets, decreases lens.len(),

## formal/verus/src/agent_select.rs
pub open spec fn key(bits: i64) -> i64 { bits ^ ((((bits >> 63i64) as u64) >> 1u64) as i64) }
pub open spec fn bits_below(a: i64, b: i64) -> bool { if a < 0 && b >= 0 { true } else if a >= 0 && b >= 0 { a < b } else if a < 0 && b < 0 { (a & 0x7fff_ffff_ffff_ffffi64) > (b & 0x7fff_ffff_ffff_ffffi64) } else { false } }
pub fn key_of_bits(bits: i64) -> (r: i64) ensures r == key(bits),
pub proof fn theorem_the_order_key_keeps_the_bit_order(a: i64, b: i64) by (bit_vector) requires a != i64::MIN, b != i64::MIN, ensures bits_below(a, b) <==> key(a) < key(b), a == b <==> key(a) == key(b),
pub open spec fn spec_pick(best: Option < (u32, i64) >, next: (u32, Option < i64 >)) -> Option < (u32, i64) > { match next.1 { None => best, Some(key) => match best { None => Some((next.0, key)), Some(b) => if key > b.1 || (key == b.1 && next.0 < b.0) { Some((next.0, key)) } else { best }, }, } }
pub open spec fn chosen(s: Seq < (u32, Option < i64 >) >) -> Option < (u32, i64) > decreases s.len(), { if s.len() == 0 { None } else { spec_pick(chosen(s.drop_last()), s.last()) } }
pub open spec fn covers(w: (u32, i64), e: (u32, Option < i64 >)) -> bool { match e.1 { None => true, Some(k) => k < w.1 || (k == w.1 && w.0 <= e.0), } }
pub fn pick(best: Option < (u32, i64) >, next: (u32, Option < i64 >)) -> (r: Option < (u32, i64) >) ensures r == spec_pick(best, next),

pub proof fn theorem_the_winner_has_the_top_score(s: Seq < (u32, Option < i64 >) >) ensures chosen(s) is Some ==> s.contains((chosen(s).unwrap().0, Some(chosen(s).unwrap().1))), chosen(s) is Some ==> forall | i: int | 0 <= i < s.len() && (#[trigger] s [i]).1 is Some ==> s [i].1.unwrap() <= chosen(s,).unwrap().1, chosen(s) is Some ==> forall | i: int | 0 <= i < s.len() && (#[trigger] s [i]).1 == Some(chosen(s).unwrap().1) ==> chosen(s,).unwrap().0 <= s [i].0,

## formal/verus/src/agent_siblings.rs
pub open spec fn share(remaining: int, siblings: int, index: int) -> int { if index < remaining % siblings { remaining / siblings + 1 } else { remaining / siblings } }
pub open spec fn total(remaining: int, siblings: int, n: int) -> int decreases n, { if n <= 0 { 0 } else { total(remaining, siblings, n - 1) + share(remaining, siblings, n - 1) } }

pub open spec fn spec_jitter(slot: int, mix: int) -> int { (slot * mix) / two64() }
pub open spec fn saturate(n: int) -> int { if n > u128::MAX as int { u128::MAX as int } else { n } }

pub open spec fn spec_accepts(batch_len: int, max_batch: int, same_tenure: bool, execution_in_batch: bool,) -> bool { batch_len < max_batch && same_tenure &&! execution_in_batch }
pub fn accepts(batch_len: usize, max_batch: usize, same_tenure: bool, execution_in_batch: bool,) -> (r: bool) ensures r == spec_accepts(batch_len as int, max_batch as int, same_tenure, execution_in_batch),
pub fn acknowledges(stage_passed: bool, batch_committed: bool) -> (r: bool) ensures r == (stage_passed && batch_committed), r ==> batch_committed, r ==> stage_passed,
proof fn lemma_share_bounds(queued: int, width: int) requires 0 <= queued <= usize::MAX, 1 <= width, ensures queued % width != 0 ==> queued / width + 1 <= usize::MAX, (queued / width + if queued % width == 0 { 0int } else { 1int }) * width >= queued,
pub fn share(queued: usize, width: usize, max_batch: usize) -> (r: usize) requires max_batch >= 1, ensures 1 <= r <= max_batch, r < max_batch ==> r * (if width == 0 { 1 } else { width }) >= queued,
pub struct Entry { pub tenure: int, pub execution: int, }
pub open spec fn has_execution(queue: Seq < Entry >, batch: Seq < int >, execution: int) -> bool { exists | k: int | 0 <= k < batch.len() && #[trigger] queue [batch [k]].execution == execution }
pub open spec fn plan_from(queue: Seq < Entry >, own: int, max_batch: int, i: int, batch: Seq < int >,) -> Seq < int > decreases queue.len() - i, { if i >= queue.len() || i < 0 { batch } else if i != own && spec_accepts(batch.len() as int, max_batch, queue [i].tenure == queue [own].tenure, has_execution(queue, batch, queue [i].execution),) { plan_from(queue, own, max_batch, i + 1, batch.push(i)) } else { plan_from(queue, own, max_batch, i + 1, batch) } }
pub open spec fn plan(queue: Seq < Entry >, own: int, max_batch: int) -> Seq < int > { if 0 <= own < queue.len() && max_batch >= 1 { plan_from(queue, own, max_batch, 0, seq ! [own]) } else { seq ! [] } }
pub open spec fn well_formed(queue: Seq < Entry >, own: int, max_batch: int, batch: Seq < int >) -> bool { &&& 0 <= own < queue.len() &&& 1 <= batch.len() <= max_batch &&& batch [0] == own &&& forall | k: int | 0 <= k < batch.len() ==> 0 <= #[trigger] batch [k] < queue.len() &&& forall | k: int | 0 <= k < batch.len() ==> #[trigger] queue [batch [k]].tenure == queue [own].tenure &&& forall | j: int, k: int | 0 <= j < k < batch.len() ==> #[trigger] queue [batch [j]].execution != #[trigger] queue [batch [k]].execution }
proof fn lemma_plan_from_keeps_the_rules(queue: Seq < Entry >, own: int, max_batch: int, i: int, batch: Seq < int >,) requires 0 <= i, well_formed(queue, own, max_batch, batch), ensures well_formed(queue, own, max_batch, plan_from(queue, own, max_batch, i, batch)), decreases queue.len() - i,
pub proof fn theorem_a_plan_keeps_every_rule(queue: Seq < Entry >, own: int, max_batch: int) requires 0 <= own < queue.len(), max_batch >= 1, ensures well_formed(queue, own, max_batch, plan(queue, own, max_batch)),
pub proof fn theorem_no_leader_plans_nothing(queue: Seq < Entry >, own: int, max_batch: int) requires own < 0 || own >= queue.len() || max_batch < 1, ensures plan(queue, own, max_batch).len() == 0,
pub open spec fn commits(fence_errors: Seq < bool >, commit_ok: bool) -> bool { commit_ok && forall | k: int | 0 <= k < fence_errors.len() ==>! #[trigger] fence_errors [k] }
pub open spec fn acked(stages: Seq < bool >, fence_errors: Seq < bool >, commit_ok: bool, i: int) -> bool { stages [i] && commits(fence_errors, commit_ok) }
pub proof fn theorem_a_result_depends_on_its_own_stage_and_the_batch(stages: Seq < bool >, fence_errors: Seq < bool >, commit_ok: bool, i: int, j: int, other: bool,) requires stages.len() == fence_errors.len(), 0 <= i < stages.len(), 0 <= j < stages.len(), i != j, ensures acked(stages.update(j, other), fence_errors, commit_ok, i) == acked(stages, fence_errors, commit_ok, i,), fence_errors [j] ==>! acked(stages, fence_errors, commit_ok, i), ! commit_ok ==>! acked(stages, fence_errors, commit_ok, i), ! stages [i] ==>! acked(stages, fence_errors, commit_ok, i),

## formal/verus/src/mixers.rs
pub open spec fn modulus() -> int { 0x1_0000_0000_0000_0000 }
pub open spec fn mul(x: u64, c: u64) -> u64 { ((x as int * c as int) % modulus()) as u64 }
pub open spec fn xs(x: u64, s: u64) -> u64 { x ^ (x >> s) }
pub open spec fn spec_mix64(x: u64) -> u64 { xs(mul(xs(mul(xs(x, 30), 0xbf58_476d_1ce4_e5b9), 27), 0x94d0_49bb_1331_11eb), 31) }
pub open spec fn spec_unmix64(y: u64) -> u64 { let d = y ^ (y >> 31) ^ (y >> 62); let c = mul(d, 0x3196_42b2_d24d_8ec3); let b = c ^ (c >> 27) ^ (c >> 54); let a = mul(b, 0x96de_1b17_3f11_9089); a ^ (a >> 30) ^ (a >> 60) }
pub open spec fn spec_splitmix64(seed: u64) -> u64 { spec_mix64(((seed as int + 0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15) % modulus()) as u64) }
pub open spec fn spec_unsplitmix64(y: u64) -> u64 { ((spec_unmix64(y) as int - 0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15 + modulus()) % modulus()) as u64 }
proof fn lemma_xs30(x: u64) by (bit_vector) ensures ({ let y = x ^ (x >> 30); y ^ (y >> 30) ^ (y >> 60) }) == x, ({ let y = x ^ (x >> 30) ^ (x >> 60); y ^ (y >> 30) }) == x,
proof fn lemma_xs27(x: u64) by (bit_vector) ensures ({ let y = x ^ (x >> 27); y ^ (y >> 27) ^ (y >> 54) }) == x, ({ let y = x ^ (x >> 27) ^ (x >> 54); y ^ (y >> 27) }) == x,
proof fn lemma_xs31(x: u64) by (bit_vector) ensures ({ let y = x ^ (x >> 31); y ^ (y >> 31) ^ (y >> 62) }) == x, ({ let y = x ^ (x >> 31) ^ (x >> 62); y ^ (y >> 31) }) == x,
proof fn lemma_mul_inverse(x: u64, c: u64, ci: u64, k: int) requires c as int * ci as int == k * modulus() + 1, ensures mul(mul(x, c), ci) == x,
proof fn lemma_mixer_constants() ensures 0xbf58_476d_1ce4_e5b9int * 0x96de_1b17_3f11_9089int == 8125545580553827436int * modulus() + 1, 0x94d0_49bb_1331_11ebint * 0x3196_42b2_d24d_8ec3int == 2077064247507883091int * modulus() + 1,
pub proof fn lemma_unmix64_inverts_mix64(x: u64) ensures spec_unmix64(spec_mix64(x)) == x,
pub proof fn lemma_mix64_inverts_unmix64(y: u64) ensures spec_mix64(spec_unmix64(y)) == y,
pub proof fn theorem_mix64_is_a_bijection() ensures forall | x: u64, y: u64 | #[trigger] spec_mix64(x) == #[trigger] spec_mix64(y) ==> x == y, forall | y: u64 | spec_mix64(#[trigger] spec_unmix64(y)) == y,
pub proof fn theorem_splitmix64_is_a_bijection() ensures forall | x: u64 | #[trigger] spec_unsplitmix64(spec_splitmix64(x)) == x, forall | x: u64, y: u64 | #[trigger] spec_splitmix64(x) == #[trigger] spec_splitmix64(y) ==> x == y,
pub fn mix64(mut x: u64) -> (r: u64) ensures r == spec_mix64(x),
pub fn dlq_mix64(seed: u64) -> (r: u64) ensures r == spec_mix64(seed),
pub fn splitmix64(seed: u64) -> (r: u64) ensures r == spec_splitmix64(seed),

## formal/verus/src/overlay_log.rs
pub open spec fn spec_next_overlay_version(latest: Option < u64 >) -> Option < u64 > { match latest { None => Some(1u64), Some(last) => if last < u64::MAX { Some((last + 1) as u64) } else { None }, } }
pub fn next_overlay_version(latest: Option < u64 >) -> (r: Option < u64 >) ensures r == spec_next_overlay_version(latest), latest.is_none() ==> r == Some(1u64), latest.is_some() && r.is_some() ==> r.unwrap() == latest.unwrap() + 1, r.is_none() ==> latest == Some(u64::MAX),
pub enum ActivateDecision { Activate, UnknownVersion, Conflict, }
pub open spec fn spec_decide_activate(known: bool, expected: Option < u64 >, actual: Option < u64 >) -> ActivateDecision { if ! known { ActivateDecision::UnknownVersion } else if expected == actual { ActivateDecision::Activate } else { ActivateDecision::Conflict } }
pub fn decide_activate(known: bool, expected: Option < u64 >, actual: Option < u64 >) -> (r: ActivateDecision) ensures r == spec_decide_activate(known, expected, actual), ! known <==> r == ActivateDecision::UnknownVersion, r == ActivateDecision::Activate <==> known && expected == actual,
pub struct Log { pub bodies: Seq < int >, pub active: Option < u64 >, }
pub open spec fn latest(log: Log) -> Option < u64 > { if log.bodies.len() == 0 { None } else { Some(log.bodies.len() as u64) } }
pub open spec fn holds(log: Log, v: u64) -> bool { 1 <= v && v <= log.bodies.len() }
pub open spec fn inv(log: Log) -> bool { log.bodies.len() <= u64::MAX && match log.active { None => true, Some(v) => holds(log, v), } }
pub open spec fn put(log: Log, body: int) -> Log { if spec_next_overlay_version(latest(log)).is_some() { Log { bodies: log.bodies.push(body), active: log.active } } else { log } }
pub open spec fn activate(log: Log, v: u64, expected: Option < u64 >) -> Log { if spec_decide_activate(holds(log, v), expected, log.active) == ActivateDecision::Activate { Log { bodies: log.bodies, active: Some(v) } } else { log } }
pub enum Op { Put(int), Activate(u64, Option < u64 >), }
pub open spec fn step(log: Log, op: Op) -> Log { match op { Op::Put(body) => put(log, body), Op::Activate(v, expected) => activate(log, v, expected), } }
pub open spec fn run(log: Log, ops: Seq < Op >) -> Log decreases ops.len(), { if ops.len() == 0 { log } else { run(step(log, ops [0]), ops.drop_first()) } }
pub proof fn theorem_a_put_appends_a_new_top_version(log: Log, body: int) requires inv(log), log.bodies.len() < u64::MAX, ensures spec_next_overlay_version(latest(log)) == Some((log.bodies.len() + 1) as u64), forall | v: u64 | holds(log, v) ==> v < log.bodies.len() + 1, put(log, body).bodies.len() == log.bodies.len() + 1, put(log, body).bodies.subrange(0, log.bodies.len() as int) == log.bodies, put(log, body).bodies [log.bodies.len() as int] == body, put(log, body).active == log.active, inv(put(log, body)),
pub proof fn theorem_a_refused_activate_changes_nothing(log: Log, v: u64, expected: Option < u64 >) ensures ! holds(log, v) ==> activate(log, v, expected) == log, expected != log.active ==> activate(log, v, expected) == log, activate(log, v, expected).bodies == log.bodies,
pub proof fn theorem_a_step_keeps_the_invariant(log: Log, op: Op) requires inv(log), ensures inv(step(log, op)),
pub proof fn theorem_no_call_rewrites_a_version(log: Log, ops: Seq < Op >) requires inv(log), ensures inv(run(log, ops)), log.bodies.len() <= run(log, ops).bodies.len(), run(log, ops).bodies.subrange(0, log.bodies.len() as int) == log.bodies, decreases ops.len(),
pub proof fn theorem_exactly_one_of_two_activates_wins(log: Log, first: u64, second: u64) requires inv(log), holds(log, first), holds(log, second), log.active != Some(first), ensures spec_decide_activate(holds(log, first), log.active, log.active) == ActivateDecision::Activate, activate(log, first, log.active).active == Some(first), spec_decide_activate(holds(activate(log, first, log.active), second), log.active, activate(log, first, log.active).active,) == ActivateDecision::Conflict, activate(activate(log, first, log.active), second, log.active) == activate(log, first, log.active,),
pub fn logs_activation(actual: Option < u64 >, version: u64) -> (r: bool) ensures r <==> actual != Some(version),
pub struct RollbackPlan { pub target: u64, pub expected: u64, }
pub open spec fn spec_rollback_target(from: Option < u64 >, to: u64) -> Option < RollbackPlan > { match from { Some(target) => Some(RollbackPlan { target, expected: to }), None => None, } }
pub fn rollback_target(from: Option < u64 >, to: u64) -> (r: Option < RollbackPlan >) ensures r == spec_rollback_target(from, to), r.is_none() <==> from.is_none(), r.is_some() ==> r.unwrap().target == from.unwrap() && r.unwrap().expected == to,
pub open spec fn spec_decide_rollback(known: bool, expected: u64, actual: Option < u64 >, read_seq: u64, last_seq: Option < u64 >,) -> ActivateDecision { if spec_decide_activate(known, Some(expected), actual) != ActivateDecision::Activate { spec_decide_activate(known, Some(expected), actual) } else if last_seq == Some(read_seq) { ActivateDecision::Activate } else { ActivateDecision::Conflict } }
pub fn decide_rollback(known: bool, expected: u64, actual: Option < u64 >, read_seq: u64, last_seq: Option < u64 >,) -> (r: ActivateDecision) ensures r == spec_decide_rollback(known, expected, actual, read_seq, last_seq), r == ActivateDecision::Activate ==> last_seq == Some(read_seq), r == ActivateDecision::Activate ==> known && actual == Some(expected),
pub struct Move { pub from: Option < u64 >, pub to: u64, }
pub struct Heads { pub stored: u64, pub active: Option < u64 >, pub moves: Seq < Move >, }
pub open spec fn chained(h: Heads) -> bool { &&& (h.moves.len() == 0 ==> h.active.is_none()) &&& (h.moves.len() > 0 ==> h.active == Some(h.moves.last().to)) &&& (h.moves.len() > 0 ==> h.moves [0].from.is_none()) &&& forall | i: int | 0 < i < h.moves.len() ==> #[trigger] h.moves [i].from == Some(h.moves [i - 1].to) &&& forall | i: int | 0 <= i < h.moves.len() ==> #[trigger] h.moves [i].from != Some(h.moves [i].to) &&& forall | i: int | 0 <= i < h.moves.len() ==> 1 <= #[trigger] h.moves [i].to <= h.stored }
pub open spec fn activate_logged(h: Heads, v: u64, expected: Option < u64 >) -> Heads { let known = 1 <= v && v <= h.stored; if spec_decide_activate(known, expected, h.active) != ActivateDecision::Activate { h } else if h.active == Some(v) { h } else { Heads { stored: h.stored, active: Some(v), moves: h.moves.push(Move { from: h.active, to: v }) } } }
pub open spec fn rollback(h: Heads) -> Heads { if h.moves.len() == 0 { h } else { match spec_rollback_target(h.moves.last().from, h.moves.last().to) { None => h, Some(plan) => activate_logged(h, plan.target, Some(plan.expected)), } } }
pub proof fn theorem_an_activation_keeps_the_chain(h: Heads, v: u64, expected: Option < u64 >) requires chained(h), ensures chained(activate_logged(h, v, expected)), activate_logged(h, v, expected).stored == h.stored,
pub proof fn theorem_a_rollback_keeps_the_chain(h: Heads) requires chained(h), ensures chained(rollback(h)),
pub proof fn theorem_a_rollback_with_no_earlier_activation_changes_nothing(h: Heads) requires chained(h), h.moves.len() == 0 || h.moves.last().from.is_none(), ensures rollback(h) == h,
pub proof fn theorem_a_rollback_restores_the_version_before(h: Heads) requires chained(h), h.moves.len() > 0, h.moves.last().from.is_some(), 1 <= h.moves.last().from.unwrap() <= h.stored, ensures rollback(h).active == h.moves.last().from, rollback(h).moves.len() == h.moves.len() + 1, rollback(h).moves.last() == (Move { from: h.active, to: h.moves.last().from.unwrap() }), rollback(rollback(h)).active == h.active,
pub proof fn theorem_a_rollback_after_v1_then_v2_makes_v1_active(stored: u64) requires stored >= 2, ensures rollback(activate_logged(activate_logged(Heads { stored, active: None, moves: Seq::empty() }, 1, None), 2, Some(1u64),),).active == Some(1u64),
pub proof fn theorem_exactly_one_of_two_rollbacks_wins(h: Heads) requires chained(h), h.moves.len() > 0, h.moves.last().from.is_some(), 1 <= h.moves.last().from.unwrap() <= h.stored, ensures rollback(h).active != h.active, activate_logged(rollback(h), h.moves.last().from.unwrap(), Some(h.moves.last().to)) == rollback(h),
pub open spec fn last_seq(h: Heads) -> Option < u64 > { if h.moves.len() == 0 { None } else { Some(h.moves.len() as u64) } }
pub open spec fn rollback_swap(h: Heads, plan: RollbackPlan, read_seq: u64) -> Heads { let known = 1 <= plan.target && plan.target <= h.stored; if spec_decide_rollback(known, plan.expected, h.active, read_seq, last_seq(h)) != ActivateDecision::Activate { h } else if h.active == Some(plan.target) { h } else { Heads { stored: h.stored, active: Some(plan.target), moves: h.moves.push(Move { from: h.active, to: plan.target }), } } }
pub proof fn theorem_a_stale_rollback_changes_nothing(h: Heads, plan: RollbackPlan, read_seq: u64) requires h.moves.len() <= u64::MAX, last_seq(h) != Some(read_seq), ensures rollback_swap(h, plan, read_seq) == h,
pub proof fn theorem_a_fresh_rollback_swap_is_the_rollback(h: Heads) requires chained(h), h.moves.len() > 0, h.moves.len() <= u64::MAX, h.moves.last().from.is_some(), ensures rollback_swap(h, spec_rollback_target(h.moves.last().from, h.moves.last().to).unwrap(), h.moves.len() as u64,) == rollback(h),
pub proof fn theorem_a_move_away_and_back_fails_a_stale_rollback(h: Heads) requires chained(h), h.stored >= 3, h.moves.len() > 0, h.moves.len() < 1000, h.active == Some(2u64), h.moves.last().from == Some(1u64), ensures rollback_swap(activate_logged(activate_logged(h, 3, Some(2u64)), 2, Some(3u64)), RollbackPlan { target: 1, expected: 2 }, h.moves.len() as u64,) == activate_logged(activate_logged(h, 3, Some(2u64)), 2, Some(3u64)), activate_logged(activate_logged(h, 3, Some(2u64)), 2, Some(3u64)).active == Some(2u64),
pub enum AutoMoveDecision { Move, Conflict, CapReached, }
pub open spec fn spec_decide_auto_move(expected: Option < u64 >, actual: Option < u64 >, used: u64, cap: Option < u32 >,) -> AutoMoveDecision { if expected != actual { AutoMoveDecision::Conflict } else { match cap { Some(limit) => if used >= limit as u64 { AutoMoveDecision::CapReached } else { AutoMoveDecision::Move }, None => AutoMoveDecision::Move, } } }
pub fn decide_auto_move(expected: Option < u64 >, actual: Option < u64 >, used: u64, cap: Option < u32 >) -> (r: AutoMoveDecision) ensures r == spec_decide_auto_move(expected, actual, used, cap), r is Move ==> expected == actual, r is Move && cap is Some ==> used < cap -> 0 as u64,
pub open spec fn spec_auto_day(cap: Option < u32 >, used: u64, attempts: nat) -> u64 decreases attempts, { if attempts == 0 { used } else { let next = if spec_decide_auto_move(None, None, used, cap) is Move { (used + 1) as u64 } else { used }; spec_auto_day(cap, next, (attempts - 1) as nat) } }
pub proof fn theorem_an_auto_day_never_passes_the_cap(limit: u32, used: u64, attempts: nat) requires used <= limit as u64, ensures spec_auto_day(Some(limit), used, attempts) <= limit as u64, decreases attempts,
pub proof fn theorem_a_stale_auto_move_conflicts(expected: Option < u64 >, actual: Option < u64 >, used: u64, cap: Option < u32 >,) requires expected != actual, ensures spec_decide_auto_move(expected, actual, used, cap) is Conflict,

## formal/verus/src/owner_fence.rs
pub fn next_epoch(epoch: i64) -> (r: Option < i64 >) ensures epoch < i64::MAX ==> r == Some((epoch + 1) as i64), epoch == i64::MAX ==> r == None::< i64 >,
pub fn fence_passes(pinned: i64, row: i64, holder_matches: bool) -> (r: bool) ensures r == (holder_matches && pinned == row), pinned < row ==>! r, pinned > row ==>! r,
pub enum LeaseOp { Acquire, Renew, Release, Expire, }
pub open spec fn step(epoch: int, op: LeaseOp) -> int { match op { LeaseOp::Acquire => epoch + 1, _ => epoch, } }
pub open spec fn run(epoch: int, ops: Seq < LeaseOp >) -> int decreases ops.len(), { if ops.len() == 0 { epoch } else { run(step(epoch, ops [0]), ops.drop_first()) } }
pub open spec fn acquisitions(ops: Seq < LeaseOp >) -> int decreases ops.len(), { if ops.len() == 0 { 0 } else { let head = match ops [0] { LeaseOp::Acquire => 1int, _ => 0int, }; head + acquisitions(ops.drop_first()) } }
proof fn lemma_run_counts_acquisitions(epoch: int, ops: Seq < LeaseOp >) ensures run(epoch, ops) == epoch + acquisitions(ops), acquisitions(ops) >= 0, decreases ops.len(),
pub proof fn theorem_the_epoch_never_falls(epoch: int, ops: Seq < LeaseOp >) ensures run(epoch, ops) >= epoch,
pub proof fn theorem_only_an_acquisition_moves_the_epoch(epoch: int, ops: Seq < LeaseOp >) requires acquisitions(ops) == 0, ensures run(epoch, ops) == epoch,
pub proof fn theorem_a_takeover_fences_the_old_tenure(pinned: int, ops: Seq < LeaseOp >, holder_matches: bool,) requires acquisitions(ops) > 0, ensures run(pinned, ops) > pinned, ! (holder_matches && pinned == run(pinned, ops)),
pub open spec fn batch(epochs: Seq < int >, locked: Set < int >) -> Seq < int > { Seq::new(epochs.len(), | p: int | if locked.contains(p) { step(epochs [p], LeaseOp::Acquire) } else { epochs [p] },) }
pub proof fn theorem_a_batch_is_one_acquisition_per_locked_row(epochs: Seq < int >, locked: Set < int >, p: int,) requires 0 <= p < epochs.len(), ensures batch(epochs, locked).len() == epochs.len(), locked.contains(p) ==> batch(epochs, locked) [p] == run(epochs [p], seq ! [LeaseOp::Acquire]), ! locked.contains(p) ==> batch(epochs, locked) [p] == epochs [p],
pub proof fn theorem_a_batch_fences_only_its_locked_rows(epochs: Seq < int >, locked: Set < int >, p: int, holder_matches: bool,) requires 0 <= p < epochs.len(), ensures locked.contains(p) ==>! (holder_matches && epochs [p] == batch(epochs, locked) [p]), ! locked.contains(p) ==> epochs [p] == batch(epochs, locked) [p],
pub open spec fn skip_locked(wanted: Set < int >, takeable: Set < int >, busy: Set < int >) -> Set < int > { wanted.intersect(takeable).difference(busy) }
pub proof fn theorem_a_batch_keeps_each_epoch_under_a_commit(epochs: Seq < int >, wanted: Set < int >, takeable: Set < int >, busy: Set < int >, p: int, pinned: int, holder_matches: bool,) requires 0 <= p < epochs.len(), ensures busy.contains(p) ==> batch(epochs, skip_locked(wanted, takeable, busy)) [p] == epochs [p], busy.contains(p) && holder_matches && pinned == epochs [p] ==> (holder_matches && pinned == batch(epochs, skip_locked(wanted, takeable, busy)) [p]), batch(epochs, skip_locked(wanted, takeable, busy)) [p] != epochs [p] ==> (wanted.contains(p) && takeable.contains(p) &&! busy.contains(p)),

## formal/verus/src/refine_policy.rs
pub enum AdoptDecision { Adopt, Unchanged, NeedsApproval, CapReached, }
pub open spec fn spec_parts_allowed(changed: u8, allowed: u8) -> bool { changed &! allowed == 0 }
pub fn parts_allowed(changed: u8, allowed: u8) -> (r: bool) ensures r == spec_parts_allowed(changed, allowed),
pub open spec fn spec_decide_adoption(allowed: u8, changed: u8, used_today: u32, cap: Option < u32 >,) -> AdoptDecision { if changed == 0 { AdoptDecision::Unchanged } else if ! spec_parts_allowed(changed, allowed) { AdoptDecision::NeedsApproval } else { match cap { Some(limit) => if used_today < limit { AdoptDecision::Adopt } else { AdoptDecision::CapReached }, None => AdoptDecision::Adopt, } } }
pub fn decide_adoption(allowed: u8, changed: u8, used_today: u32, cap: Option < u32 >) -> (r: AdoptDecision) ensures r == spec_decide_adoption(allowed, changed, used_today, cap), r is Adopt ==> changed != 0, r is Adopt ==> spec_parts_allowed(changed, allowed), r is Adopt && cap is Some ==> used_today < cap -> 0,
proof fn lemma_nothing_allowed(changed: u8) by (bit_vector) requires changed != 0, ensures changed &! 0u8 != 0,
proof fn lemma_superset_allows(changed: u8, allowed: u8, wider: u8) by (bit_vector) requires changed &! allowed == 0, allowed &! wider == 0, ensures changed &! wider == 0,
pub proof fn theorem_the_default_never_adopts(changed: u8, used_today: u32, cap: Option < u32 >) ensures ! (spec_decide_adoption(0, changed, used_today, cap) is Adopt),
pub proof fn theorem_an_empty_change_is_unchanged(allowed: u8, used_today: u32, cap: Option < u32 >) ensures spec_decide_adoption(allowed, 0, used_today, cap) is Unchanged,
pub proof fn theorem_a_wider_policy_keeps_an_adoption(allowed: u8, wider: u8, changed: u8, used_today: u32, cap: Option < u32 >,) requires allowed &! wider == 0, spec_decide_adoption(allowed, changed, used_today, cap) is Adopt, ensures spec_decide_adoption(wider, changed, used_today, cap) is Adopt,
pub open spec fn spec_day(allowed: u8, cap: Option < u32 >, used: u32, changes: Seq < u8 >,) -> u32 decreases changes.len(), { if changes.len() == 0 { used } else { let next = if spec_decide_adoption(allowed, changes [0], used, cap) is Adopt { (used + 1) as u32 } else { used }; spec_day(allowed, cap, next, changes.subrange(1, changes.len() as int)) } }
pub proof fn theorem_a_day_never_passes_the_cap(allowed: u8, limit: u32, used: u32, changes: Seq < u8 >,) requires used <= limit, ensures spec_day(allowed, Some(limit), used, changes) <= limit, decreases changes.len(),
pub proof fn theorem_a_full_day_adopts_nothing(allowed: u8, limit: u32, used: u32, changed: u8) requires used >= limit, ensures ! (spec_decide_adoption(allowed, changed, used, Some(limit)) is Adopt),
pub open spec fn spec_gate_timed_out(requested_ms: u64, now_ms: u64, timeout_ms: u64) -> bool { now_ms as int >= requested_ms as int + timeout_ms as int }
pub fn gate_timed_out(requested_ms: u64, now_ms: u64, timeout_ms: u64) -> (r: bool) ensures r == spec_gate_timed_out(requested_ms, now_ms, timeout_ms),
pub proof fn theorem_a_timeout_is_final(requested_ms: u64, now_ms: u64, later_ms: u64, timeout_ms: u64,) requires spec_gate_timed_out(requested_ms, now_ms, timeout_ms), later_ms >= now_ms, ensures spec_gate_timed_out(requested_ms, later_ms, timeout_ms),

## formal/verus/src/scan_skip.rs
pub open spec fn skips(next: Seq < usize >, dead: Set < int >, k: int) -> bool { forall | m: int | k <= m < next [k] ==> #[trigger] dead.contains(m) }
pub open spec fn links(next: Seq < usize >, dead: Set < int >) -> bool { &&& next.len() > 0 &&& next [next.len() - 1] == next.len() - 1 &&& forall | k: int | 0 <= k < next.len() ==> k <= #[trigger] next [k] < next.len() &&& forall | k: int | 0 <= k < next.len() ==> #[trigger] skips(next, dead, k) }
proof fn lemma_a_halving_keeps_the_links(next: Seq < usize >, dead: Set < int >, i: int) requires links(next, dead), 0 <= i < next.len(), ensures links(next.update(i, next [next [i] as int]), dead), next [next [i] as int] >= next [i] >= i, forall | m: int | i <= m < next [next [i] as int] ==> #[trigger] dead.contains(m),
proof fn lemma_a_dead_link_keeps_the_links(next: Seq < usize >, dead: Set < int >, i: int) requires links(next, dead), 0 <= i < next.len() - 1, dead.contains(i), ensures links(next.update(i, (i + 1) as usize), dead),
pub fn first_live(next:& mut [usize], from: usize, is_dead: impl Fn(usize) -> bool, Ghost(dead) : Ghost < Set < int >>,) -> (r: usize) requires links(old(next) @, dead), from < old(next).len(), forall | j: usize | j + 1 < old(next).len() ==> is_dead.requires ((j,)), forall | j: usize, b: bool | is_dead.ensures ((j,), b) ==> b == dead.contains(j as int), ensures links(final(next) @, dead), final(next).len() == old(next).len(), from <= r < final(next).len(), r == final(next).len() - 1 ||! dead.contains(r as int), forall | m: int | from <= m < r ==> #[trigger] dead.contains(m),
pub proof fn theorem_a_new_list_is_sound(next: Seq < usize >, dead: Set < int >) requires next.len() > 0, forall | k: int | 0 <= k < next.len() ==> #[trigger] next [k] == k, ensures links(next, dead),
pub proof fn theorem_an_added_entry_keeps_the_links(next: Seq < usize >, dead: Set < int >) requires links(next, dead), next.len() < usize::MAX, ensures links(next.push(next.len() as usize), dead),
pub proof fn theorem_more_dead_entries_keep_the_links(next: Seq < usize >, dead: Set < int >, more: Set < int >,) requires links(next, dead), dead.subset_of(more), ensures links(next, more),
